Q2_failure_buckets.notes: All 8 duplicate hash clusters classified LEGITIMATE DUPLICATE (intra_run vs CREATED). Zero bank/fingerprint collisions. Zero false-positive suspects with evidence.

questions.Q3_factory_vs_yield: Expected yield limitation under fixed safety caps + narrow single-concept Chemistry allocation, not a factory safety/code defect. Gates (parse/validate/dedupe/attempt cap) operated correctly.
questions.Q4_proceed_p4_p5: YES for P4/P5 on the existing ~95 DRAFT population. Roadmap/DoD use ~100 (approximate) and sequence generate then P4 QA then P5 sample; they do not require exact 100/100 created before QA. Do not invent Chemistry fill. Chemistry coverage shortfall is a separate refill decision after remediation.

Keep attempt multiplier, duplicate stem_hash, parser, and validation unchanged.
Optional prompt hygiene for Chemistry: emphasize raw JSON and avoid LaTeX-style backslash escapes (model output defect), without relaxing parse_mcq_json.
Do not raise caps/budget to force 25/25 on one concept.
